title: Tracking URI in mlflow-artifacts scheme error must be redacted of credentials before logging
answers: tracing exporter logs database password in cleartext when server runs with --serve-artifacts
mlflow-artifacts tracking URI must be a valid http or https URI error leaks credentials
postgresql password appears in MLflow server warning log
redact userinfo from tracking URI in error message
body:
Symptom: With `--serve-artifacts` and a credentialed backend store URI (e.g. `postgresql://user:password@host/db`), the tracing exporter logs a WARNING that contains the database password in cleartext.
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/mlflow_artifacts_repo.py:_validate_uri_scheme interpolated the full `parsed_uri.geturl()` (userinfo and query included) into the MlflowException message. The server's global tracking URI is its backend store URI, so the message carried that credential.
Fix pattern: Build the message from a redacted copy: drop userinfo (`netloc.rpartition("@")`) and clear params, query, and fragment via `_replace(...)`, then format that copy. Any new error or log that prints a tracking/store URI should go through the same kind of redaction rather than printing the raw URI.
Constraints: Applies to URIs that fail the http/https scheme check. Dropping the whole query also removes non-secret options such as `sslmode`, which is accepted. Only this error path was changed; other places that format store URIs are not covered by this fix.
applies: Any change to mlflow-artifacts URI resolution or to error/log messages that embed tracking or backend store URIs in mlflow/store/artifact/.
says: Database credentials appear in server logs when artifact serving fails.
Redact database passwords from error logs when artifact storage validation fails.
The server warning log exposes cleartext database credentials during artifact resolution.
Hide sensitive connection credentials in artifact server warning messages.
search: Error messages in mlflow/store/artifact/mlflow_artifacts_repo.py:_validate_uri_scheme must format tracking URIs from a redacted copy with userinfo dropped and params, query, and fragment cleared via _replace. This prevents leaking database credentials in cleartext warning logs when running with --serve-artifacts and a backend store URI failing the http or https scheme check. Applies to changes in mlflow/store/artifact/ embedding tracking or backend store URIs; dropping query parameters removes options like sslmode, while other store URI formatting paths remain uncovered.
